    b = primitives.call(name='locate_robotwin2_actor', actor_name=name)
    return [round(v,3) for v in b.output['pose_world'][:3]]

r1 = primitives.call(name='execute_robotwin2_pick_place', arm_tag='left', source_actor_label='block2', target_actor_label='block1', lift_distance=0.15, pre_grasp_distance=0.10, pre_place_distance=0.12, evidence_handles=H2+H)
print('pp1', r1.ok, r1.output.get('completed_stages') if isinstance(r1.output, dict) else '')
print('b1', block_xyz('block1'), 'b2', block_xyz('block2'), 'b3', block_xyz('block3'))

r2 = primitives.call(name='execute_robotwin2_pick_place', arm_tag='left', source_actor_label='block3', target_actor_label='block2', lift_distance=0.15, pre_grasp_distance=0.10, pre_place_distance=0.12, evidence_handles=H3+H2)
print('pp2', r2.ok, r2.output.get('completed_stages') if isinstance(r2.output, dict) else '')
